_doc: Explicit depiction prompts for abstract nouns / homographs the image model renders wrong by default (foil->sword, nail->finger, map->doodle, trunk->elephant-trunk). Used verbatim by phonics_images._ai (inserted into the faceless OBJECT template) so a rebuild is durable instead of re-inventing the prompt each time. All entries are inanimate objects. Add a word here the first time the model draws it wrong.
wood: a stack of chopped firewood logs
foil: a roll of shiny kitchen aluminium foil
nail: a metal carpentry nail with a flat head and a pointed tip
page: a single sheet of paper page from an open book
trunk: a large travel storage trunk chest with a latch
echo: sound waves bouncing off a canyon wall
stick: a single thin wooden tree twig stick
